alt: A Foundation Series Tesla Cybertruck photographed at dusk in South San Jose, showing the flat angular stainless steel body, geometric headlight strip, and completely straight panel lines with no visible curves
story: A Bloomberg analysis published July 22, 2026 showed Tesla's Cybertruck is a bigger commercial failure relative to targets than Ford's 1957 Edsel — the historical benchmark for automotive flops — after Musk projected 250,000 annual sales but the truck managed only 3,519 deliveries in Q1 2026 and fewer than 8,000 units through May 2026, with stock falling 18% in a week.
why_funny: The man who promised Tesla's 'best product ever' built a stainless steel truck that looks like a refrigerator tipped on its side and sold it at one-sixth the promised annual rate — to fewer people, proportionally, than even the Edsel.
